title: Walk on spheres and Array-RQMC
summary: We use Array-RQMC sampling in a walk on spheres (WoS) algorithm for Dirichlet boundary value problems. On a collection of problems, we find that Array-RQMC-WoS reduces the Monte Carlo MSE or variance by factors ranging from $71$-fold to $3087$-fold at $n=2^{17}$ trajectories. The variance is known to be $o(1/n)$ but attains empirical rates between $n^{-1.4}$ and $n^{-1.8}$ in our examples. A simpler RQMC-WoS algorithm studied in Ho and Owen (2026) has more theoretical support but only reduced variance by 1.8 to 10.7-fold on the same set of examples.
